title: KYA BAAT!
FACTS
tagline: Har fact pe bologe: kya baat!
cta_hi: ऐसे और facts के लिए, फ़ॉलो करो!

source.cite_format: Publisher, title, year (+ URL), e.g. NASA, 'Venus', 2024
check_against: the source itself (read it), never memory; disputed or legendary claims are framed honestly ('kya sach mein?', 'it's said...')

major_characters.rule: Facts channel: the narrator (Bunty) is the only recurring voice; the googly-eyes mascot is the recurring visual (brand/kit/eye_expressions.png).

address.rule: Name a revered figure respectfully: devotees and family don't use the bare name; elders, sages and adversaries may.

instagram.say: [excited] ऐसे और मज़ेदार facts के लिए... फ़ॉलो करो!

youtube.say: [excited] ऐसे और मज़ेदार facts के लिए... सब्सक्राइब करो!

mascot: Hairaan Aankhen: two googly eyes that react in intros (Kya baat! / Hmm... / Sach mein? / Wow!) - see brand/kit/eye_expressions.png
